subject: SEC: syncProgress accepts an unvalidated client streak - full 9,125 XP in ONE call
description: Found by Mallory 2026-09-08 while auditing the orphaned updateStreak function; I verified the source myself. PRE-EXISTING, unrelated to the tournament work. functions/index.js:1721 does const localStreak = Math.max(0, Math.min(10000, parseInt(localData.streak) || 0)) - a CLAMP, not a legitimacy check. Line 1748 then does mergedStreak = Math.max(cloudData.streak || 0, localStreak) and feeds it to deriveXP, which pays DAILY_LOGIN 25/day capped at 365 = 9,125 XP. Contrast the SAME function two lines earlier: modulesCompleted and labsCompleted get .filter(_isValidModuleId).filter(_isKnownCompletion). Streak gets nothing. So one syncProgress call with {streak:10000} reaches the XP ceiling INSTANTLY. firestore.rules:139-171 (BUG-262/263) closed the direct-PATCH route to streak and documents this exact laundering mechanism as already proven against production - but rules do not govern admin-SDK writes, so the callable path was never closed. Same class as task 366 (achievements in the same function): syncProgress trusts client input for XP-bearing fields. UNPROVEN by live test - nobody has called it with a forged payload; needs a write-authorized session. Fix shape: validate streak the way modules/labs are validated, or derive it server-side rather than accepting it.
